fee_assumptions.note: Card pricing is this operator's negotiated Connect rate, effective 2024-05-09. ACH pricing and the international card share are unverified placeholders, flagged here and in the assumptions panel.

assumptions: Card pricing: 2.50% + $0.20 domestic, 4.00% + $0.20 international - negotiated rate, verified.
ACH pricing: 0.80%, capped at $5.00 - unverified placeholder, not confirmed.
International card share: 1% of card volume - unverified estimate.
Digital wallet payments are priced identically to domestic card - assumption, not a Stripe-verified rate.
The processing fee is modeled as netted from the investor's transfer, not absorbed by the operator - unconfirmed assumption.
All entity names, resident IDs, property IDs, and dollar amounts are synthetic.
